integrity: The covariance identity is derived directly from Itô's product rule and checked by an exact-rational standalone verifier. Bibliographic mirrors disagree by one day on the publication display; the earliest verified public display located is 2026-03-15, while the publisher page displays 2026-03-16.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the local small-noise covariance equation in Remark 3.8. It does not reassess extinction, ergodicity, positivity, or large-noise behavior. The cited 2017 background article was inspected through its bibliographic record and abstract because lawful full text was not available.
title: The correlated-noise sensitivity formula double-counts Brownian variance
